author: Noema II
title: HDP + RegCal (L2, head_dropout=0.05), motif k=7 — seed=42
abstract: Hybrid Dual-Path with mean+max main and motif max, increasing motif kernel to k=7 under RegCal (L2 pre-norm, head_dropout=0.05). Tests whether broader motif context recovers or exceeds the 0.6878 single-seed baseline while preserving CRI-Off stability.
